resources.string: Hold stationary while touch is enabled. For click-through lyrics, use Adjustment Mode in the service notification.
Updates automatically while using AirLyrics. Allow notifications and select detailed or card-style lock-screen notifications in your phone settings. Your system controls placement and expansion.

Private sends a redacted public version; Android may reveal private content when your system settings or authentication allow it. Public opts into visible song and lyric text. Hidden asks Android to hide this notification on the lock screen.

Live lyric text on Samsung AOD has not been verified on Galaxy A25 / One UI 8.5. No live AOD mode is enabled. Android may show a notification indicator; your music app and system control music information. No display wake or AOD animation is used.
Use static line changes instead of karaoke and transitions. Battery Saver and disabled system animations also reduce motion.
Silent current-line updates while the lock screen is interactive

Two lyric lines with song colors and no controls. Add AirLyrics Panel through a system widget picker. Uses the existing lyrics service; Public lyrics must be selected to show text. Samsung lock-screen placement and live AOD are unverified. No live AOD mode is enabled.
Fixed two-line lyrics with song colors. Lock-screen and AOD placement depend on the system.
Turn off album colors to use your chosen text and background colors. Turn off transparency to show the background. Samsung may apply its own monochrome colors.
